authors: David Angenendt, Giacomo Calzolari, Alireza Naghavi
source: Journal of the European Economic Association

abstract: We investigate the effects of trade secret (TS) protection on supplier exclusivity in vertical industrial relations. We show that manufacturers limit their suppliers’ buyer networks under weak TS protection to safeguard sensitive information while encouraging supplier investment. Using worldwide automotive parts contracts data, we find that weak TS protection constrains suppliers to serve only a few Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), sometimes leading to exclusivity, especially for parts with intermediate relationship-specificity. This association strengthens with greater OEM bargaining power, aligning with theoretical insights. We validate these findings by examining supplier attributes, including size, cartel involvement, and ownership structure. F23, O34, L14, L24, L62
abstract_zh: 我们研究了商业秘密（TS）保护对纵向产业关系中供应商排他性的影响。研究表明，在商业秘密保护较弱的情况下，制造商为保护敏感信息而限制供应商的客户网络，同时鼓励供应商进行投资。利用全球汽车零部件合同数据，我们发现，薄弱的商业秘密保护约束了供应商仅服务于少数原始设备制造商（OEMs），有时甚至导致排他性，尤其对于关系特定性中等的零部件而言。这一关联随着OEM议价能力的增强而加强，与理论见解相符。我们通过考察供应商特征（包括规模、卡特尔参与情况及所有权结构）验证了这些发现。F23, O34, L14, L24, L62

title: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
title_zh: 常规偏向型技术变革、就业结构与跨国收入差异
title_primary: 常规偏向型技术变革、就业结构与跨国收入差异
title_secondary: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
authors: Werner Peña, Christian Siegel
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate links between routine-biased technical change, the structure of occupational employment, and cross-country income differences. To implement this, we combine several data sources, including national labour force surveys and the Penn World Tables. In our novel dataset spanning 92 countries, we document a negative relationship between the employment share of routine occupations and GDP per hour worked. We then conduct a development accounting exercise in which we differentiate labour inputs by occupation and allow for occupation-specific technologies. We find a systematic relationship between occupation-specific productivities and development. Labour in routine occupations tends to be much more productive in richer countries, with effective productivity in the top 25 percent being about 14 times higher than in the bottom 25 percent of countries ranked by GDP per hour worked. Cross-country gaps in routine technology alone account for about 17 percent of the 90–10 ratio of GDP per hour worked, whereas differences in abstract labour technology do not contribute to the observed GDP dispersion. Eliminating all occupations’ and capital’s technology differences would compress the GDP distribution by 32 to 40 percent.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了常规偏向型技术变革、职业就业结构与跨国收入差异之间的联系。为实现这一目标，我们整合了包括国家劳动力调查和宾大世界表在内的多个数据源。在我们覆盖92个国家的新数据集中，我们记录了常规职业就业份额与每小时工作GDP之间的负相关关系。随后，我们进行了一项发展核算分析，按职业区分劳动投入，并允许职业特定技术的存在。我们发现，职业特定生产率与发展水平之间存在系统性关联。在较富裕国家，常规职业中的劳动力往往生产率更高，其中前25%国家的有效生产率约为按每小时工作GDP排名后25%国家的14倍。仅常规技术的跨国差距就解释了每小时工作GDP的90-10比率的约17%，而抽象劳动技术的差异并未对观察到的GDP离散度做出贡献。消除所有职业和资本的技术差异将使GDP分布压缩32%至40%。

title: The Contribution of High-Skilled Immigrants to Innovation in the United States
title_zh: 高技能移民对美国创新的贡献
title_primary: 高技能移民对美国创新的贡献
title_secondary: The Contribution of High-Skilled Immigrants to Innovation in the United States
authors: Bernstein, Shai, Diamond, Rebecca, Jiranaphawiboon, Abhisit, McQuade, Timothy, Pousada, Beatriz
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We characterize the contribution of immigrants to US innovation. Leveraging new data, we use age of SSN assignment to identify immigrant status. Immigrants represent 16 percent of inventors, but authored 23 percent of patents. Immigrant inventors contribute to knowledge diffusion across borders. They disproportionately rely on foreign technologies and inventor collaborations. Using variation from premature inventor deaths, we find immigrant inventors create stronger innovation productivity spillovers on their collaborators, as compared to US-born inventors. A simple model implies immigrants are responsible for 32 percent of aggregate innovation, over half of which is due to human capital externalities on US-born collaborators.
abstract_zh: 我们刻画了移民对美国创新的贡献。利用新数据，我们通过社保号分配年龄来识别移民身份。移民占发明者的16%，却贡献了23%的专利。移民发明者促进了知识跨国界扩散，他们不成比例地依赖外国技术和发明者合作。利用发明者早逝带来的变异，我们发现与本土出生的发明者相比，移民发明者对其合作者产生了更强的创新生产力溢出效应。一个简单模型表明，移民对总体创新的贡献占32%，其中超过一半归因于对本土合作者的人力资本外部性。

title: Optimal Stopping under Volatility Ambiguity
title_zh: 波动率模糊下的最优停止
title_primary: 波动率模糊下的最优停止
title_secondary: Optimal Stopping under Volatility Ambiguity
authors: Wenbin Cao, Xiaowei Chen, Yinghui Ye, Wei Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a verification theorem for infinite-horizon optimal stopping under G-Brownian motion and apply it to several stopping problems of economic interest. The theorem gives sufficient conditions under which a candidate solution to a system of variational inequalities is the value function under volatility, covariance, or joint drift–volatility ambiguity. In the canonical irreversible investment problem, volatility ambiguity advances investment because the worst-case scenario selects the lowest feasible volatility for a convex continuation value. Ambiguity about volatility therefore acts in the opposite direction from volatility itself, which postpones investment. In other environments, worst-case volatility can vary with the state, alter project relevance, create bilateral valuation wedges, shorten search, and change two-dimensional investment payoffs through covariance and correlation ambiguity. A common convexity-based mechanism drives these results: volatility ambiguity changes the perceived dispersion of future outcomes, whereas drift ambiguity acts through monotonicity.
abstract_zh: 我们针对G-布朗运动下的无限期最优停止问题建立了一个验证定理，并将其应用于若干具有经济意义的最优停止问题。该定理给出了充分条件，在这些条件下，变分不等式系统的候选解在波动率、协方差或联合漂移-波动率模糊性下即为价值函数。在经典不可逆投资问题中，波动率模糊性会提前投资，因为最坏情形选择对于凸的延续价值而言对应最低可行波动率。因此，关于波动率的模糊性其作用方向与波动率本身相反——后者会推迟投资。在其他环境中，最坏情形波动率可能随状态变化，改变项目的相关性，产生双边估值楔子，缩短搜寻时间，并通过协方差和相关性模糊性改变二维投资回报。一个基于凸性的共同机制驱动了这些结果：波动率模糊性改变了未来结果的感知离散度，而漂移模糊性则通过单调性发挥作用。

title: Luck Out or Outpay? Competing with a Public Option
title_zh: 侥幸胜出还是付出更多？与公共选项竞争
title_primary: 侥幸胜出还是付出更多？与公共选项竞争
title_secondary: Luck Out or Outpay? Competing with a Public Option
authors: Mekonnen, Teddy
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper analyzes the strategic interactions between a profit-maximizing monopolist and a free, capacity-constrained public option. By restricting its own supply, the monopolist intentionally congests the public option and induces rationing, which increases consumers’ willingness to pay for guaranteed access. Counterintuitively, expanding the public option’s capacity may raise the monopoly price and lower consumer welfare. I derive conditions under which all buyer types benefit from a capacity expansion, and extend these results to a setting where an oligopoly competes with a public option. These findings have implications for mixed publicprivate markets, such as housing, education, and healthcare.

title: Political Entrepreneurs
title_zh: 政治企业家
title_primary: 政治企业家
title_secondary: Political Entrepreneurs
authors: Aaron Chatterji, Jorge Guzman, Joyce Ma, Ryan C. McDevitt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms shape public policy not only from the outside through lobbying and campaign contributions, but also from the inside when business owners hold public office. We study this channel using a novel dataset that links state legislators’ personal financial disclosures to bill sponsorship records across 26 U.S. states from 2009 to 2023. The disclosures allow us to observe business ownership during legislative service and to distinguish entrepreneurs, defined as legislators who both own and actively manage a firm, from passive shareholders and employees. Applying a large language model to bill text, we classify legislation as pro-business and identify a subset of pro-entry bills that reduce barriers facing new firms. Entrepreneurs are a substantial presence in state legislatures, accounting for over 40 percent of legislators, and their representation varies primarily across states rather than within states over time. Although entrepreneurs do not sponsor more bills overall, they initiate a greater share of bills as first or sole primary sponsor. They also do not appear to be generic advocates for business. Relative to legislators with other business ties, entrepreneurs are no more likely to sponsor pro-business bills or bills endorsed by state Chambers of Commerce. Instead, they selectively advance pro-entry legislation, especially bills related to deregulation and innovation rather than antitrust or access to capital. These findings document an important channel through which entrepreneurs shape the policy environment for entrepreneurship from within political institutions.
abstract_zh: 企业不仅通过游说和竞选捐款等外部途径影响公共政策，还通过企业主担任公职这一内部渠道发挥作用。我们利用一项新颖的数据集来研究这一渠道，该数据集将美国26个州2009年至2023年间州议员的个人财务披露与法案提案记录相链接。财务披露使我们能够观察到议员在任职期间的企业所有权情况，并将企业家——即既拥有又积极管理企业的议员——与被动股东和雇员区分开来。我们运用大型语言模型对法案文本进行分类，将立法划分为亲商类型，并识别出一类减少新企业面临障碍的亲准入法案。企业家在州议会中占据重要地位，占议员总数的40%以上，其代表性差异主要体现为州际差异，而非州内随时间的变化。尽管企业家总体上并未提出更多法案，但他们作为第一或唯一主要提案人发起法案的比例更高。此外，他们并非笼统的商业利益代言人。相较于具有其他商业关联的议员，企业家提出亲商法案或获得州商会支持法案的可能性并未更高。相反，他们有针对性地推进亲准入立法，尤其是与放松管制和创新相关的法案，而非反垄断或资本获取方面的法案。这些发现揭示了企业家从政治机构内部塑造创业政策环境的重要渠道。

title: A note on the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion
title_zh: 关于赤池信息准则渐近无偏性的注记
title_primary: 关于赤池信息准则渐近无偏性的注记
title_secondary: A note on the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion
authors: Yong Li, Zhou Wu, Jun Yu, Tao Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This note revisits the standard derivation of the asymptotic unbiasedness of Akaike information criterion (AIC). The existing literature has shown that AIC is an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the predictive risk. However, there is a technical issue in these justifications. In this note, we bridge the gap and establish the asymptotic unbiasedness of AIC under certain regularity conditions, which are applicable in various scenarios. Our result suggests that AIC should be used with caution if the moment conditions on the parameter estimators may not hold. When model misspecification is allowed, our result can be extended to Takeuchi information criterion (TIC).
abstract_zh: 本注文重新审视了赤池信息准则（AIC）渐近无偏性的标准推导过程。现有文献已表明，AIC是预测风险的一个渐近无偏估计量。然而，这些论证中存在一个技术性问题。在本注文中，我们弥合了这一差距，并在一定的正则条件下确立了AIC的渐近无偏性，这些条件适用于多种情境。我们的结果表明，若参数估计量的矩条件可能不成立，则应谨慎使用AIC。当允许模型误设时，我们的结果可推广至竹内信息准则（TIC）。

title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
title_zh: 人工智能时代的纳税人行为：房产税申诉的实地实验
title_primary: 人工智能时代的纳税人行为：房产税申诉的实地实验
title_secondary: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
authors: Justin E. Holz, Ricardo Perez-Truglia, Andrew Simon, Alejandro Zentner
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment—that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.
abstract_zh: 应对税务系统往往需要纳税人可能缺乏的信息和判断力。尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但人工智能或许能以显著更低的成本提供类似的协助。然而，关于纳税人如何使用人工智能税务代理或这些工具如何影响其行为，尚无因果证据。我们通过在房产税上诉背景下的实地实验填补了这一空白。我们招募了德克萨斯州达拉斯县645户家庭作为样本。所有家庭均可访问一个提供个性化信息、申请指南及支持证据的网站。其中一半家庭被随机分配至包含人工智能聊天机器人的网站版本，该机器人能够回答提问并提供针对其具体情况定制的指导。聊天机器人的使用率很高：78%的家庭发起了对话。使用聊天机器人使无人工代理提交上诉的概率提高了9.1个百分点，从41.4%升至50.5%。点击流数据和对话记录的证据表明，聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力——即评估并利用现有信息。在条件较不利的家庭中，上诉提交的增加幅度较小，这为聊天机器人扩大了现有差距提供了提示性证据。我们的结果展示了人工智能税务协助的潜力，同时强调受益者不仅取决于获取途径，还取决于纳税人如何使用该技术。

title: Sticky Wage Norms and the Real Wage Cost of Unexpected Inflation
title_zh: 粘性工资规范与意外通胀的实际工资成本
title_primary: 粘性工资规范与意外通胀的实际工资成本
title_secondary: Sticky Wage Norms and the Real Wage Cost of Unexpected Inflation
authors: Erik Hurst, Christina Patterson, Nela Thomas Richardson, Ye Liv Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use a sample of administrative payroll data covering a large and nationally representative share of U.S. workers to study how wages adjusted during the recent inflation period. Most firms apply a single modal annual nominal wage increase to the majority of their workers, and these firm-level norms changed little during the recent period of unexpected inflation. As a result, nominal wages did not keep pace with prices for a large share of workers who stayed at their firms. Forty-three percent of workers continuously employed at the same firm over the four years spanning 2021–2024 experienced a real wage decline, with a mean loss of roughly nine percent among those who fell behind. Workers could escape sticky wage norms by changing employers — job-changers’ wages rose nearly one-for-one with inflation — but switching was too infrequent to matter for most. Even accounting for job-changers, 37 percent of all workers saw real wages decline over the 4-year period. Indexing firms’ modal raises one-for-one to inflation would have closed roughly 40 percent of the resulting shortfall relative to prepandemic trend. Drawing on cross-country evidence from Belgium, whose wages are automatically indexed to inflation, we show that incomplete wage indexation, rather than inflation itself, helps explain the persistence of depressed consumer sentiment during the 2021–2024 period.
abstract_zh: 我们利用覆盖美国工人中具有全国代表性的大样本行政工资数据，研究了近期通胀期间工资如何调整。大多数企业对其大部分员工实行单一的年度名义工资增长模式，而这些企业层面的规范在近期意外通胀期间变化甚微。因此，对于许多留在原企业的员工而言，名义工资未能跟上物价上涨的步伐。在2021年至2024年间连续在同一企业工作的员工中，有43%经历了实际工资下降，其中落后者的平均损失约为9%。员工可以通过更换雇主来规避僵化的工资规范——跳槽者的工资几乎与通胀同步上涨——但跳槽频率过低，对大多数人影响有限。即便将跳槽者考虑在内，仍有37%的全体员工在四年期间实际工资下降。若将企业的典型加薪幅度与通胀率一对一挂钩，则可弥补相对于疫情前趋势约40%的缺口。借鉴比利时（其工资自动与通胀挂钩）的跨国证据，我们表明，不完全的工资指数化，而非通胀本身，有助于解释2021-2024年间消费者情绪持续低迷的现象。

title: What drives banks’ overreaction to loan loss information? Discussion of imperfect expectations in loan loss forecasts
title_zh: 什么驱动银行对贷款损失信息的过度反应？——贷款损失预测中非完美预期的探讨

title_secondary: What drives banks’ overreaction to loan loss information? Discussion of imperfect expectations in loan loss forecasts
authors: Scott Liao, Brent A. Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Bhojraj et al. (2026) provide novel evidence that systemically large banks' internal loan loss forecasts systematically overreact to new information and that this overreaction is economically meaningful for loan loss provisioning. Our discussion focuses on whether the evidence identifies representativeness bias, as opposed to a broader set of behavioral, institutional, and economic mechanisms. We argue that the paper more convincingly documents overreaction than it isolates representativeness as the underlying mechanism. We revisit the role of bank information environment, data generating process, COVID-era uncertainty, endogenous bank responses, regulatory influences, and the interpretation of the CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) results relative to subsidiaries of IFRS 9 adopters. While several additional analyses are supportive of biased expectations, others suggest a more cautious reading of the mechanism. Our overall takeaway is that the paper's central contribution would be strengthened by framing the evidence more directly around overreaction in bank expectations formation and its implications for provisioning, while leaving greater room for multiple coexisting mechanisms and future research on how behavioral forces enter bank forecasting environments.
abstract_zh: Bhojraj等人（2026年）提供了新颖的证据，表明系统重要性银行的内部贷款损失预测系统性地对新增信息过度反应，且这种过度反应对贷款损失拨备具有经济意义上的重要性。我们的讨论聚焦于该证据是否识别出代表性偏差，而非更广泛的行为、制度及经济机制。我们认为，该论文更有说服力地记录了过度反应现象，而非将代表性偏差孤立为潜在机制。我们重新审视了银行信息环境、数据生成过程、新冠疫情时期的不确定性、银行内生反应、监管影响，以及CECL（当前预期信用损失）结果相对于采用IFRS 9的子公司之解释。尽管若干附加分析支持偏差预期的存在，但其他分析则提示应对机制解读持更为审慎的态度。总体而言，我们认为，若将证据更直接地围绕银行预期形成中的过度反应及其对拨备的影响进行框架构建，同时为多种共存机制及未来关于行为因素如何进入银行预测环境的研究留出更大空间，则该论文的核心贡献将得到加强。

title: Emerging Market Resilience: Good Luck or Good Policies?
title_zh: 新兴市场韧性：好运还是良策？
title_primary: 新兴市场韧性：好运还是良策？
title_secondary: Emerging Market Resilience: Good Luck or Good Policies?
authors: Bolhuis, Marijn, Grigoli, Francesco, Kolasa, Marcin, Meeks, Roland, Presbitero, Andrea 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Emerging markets have shown remarkable resilience during risk-off episodes in recent years. While favorable external conditions - good luck - contributed to this resilience, improvements in policy frameworks - good policies - played a critical role in bolstering the capacity of emerging markets to withstand the adverse consequences of these events. Improvements in monetary policy implementation and credibility have reduced reliance on foreign exchange (FX) interventions and capital flow management measures, and stricter macroprudential regulation also contributed to less FX interventions. Also, central banks have become less sensitive to fiscal interference and hold sway over domestic borrowing conditions. Looking ahead, countries with robust frameworks face easier policy trade-offs and are better positioned to navigate risk-off episodes. In contrast, economies with weaker frameworks risk de-anchoring inflation expectations and larger output losses if monetary tightening is delayed, especially when persistent price pressures emerge. In these settings, FX interventions offer only temporary relief and are less necessary when policy frameworks are sound.
abstract_zh: 近年来，新兴市场在风险规避时期展现出显著的韧性。尽管有利的外部环境——即"好运"——对此韧性有所贡献，但政策框架的改善——即"良政"——在增强新兴市场抵御此类事件负面冲击的能力方面发挥了关键作用。货币政策实施与可信度的提升降低了对外汇干预和资本流动管理措施的依赖，而更严格的宏观审慎监管也进一步减少了外汇干预。此外，各国央行对财政干预的敏感度降低，并掌握了国内借贷条件的主导权。展望未来，拥有健全政策框架的国家在面临更轻松的政策权衡时，能更好地应对风险规避时期。相比之下，政策框架薄弱的经济体若延迟货币紧缩，尤其是在持续价格压力出现时，将面临通胀预期脱锚及更大产出损失的风险。在此类情境下，外汇干预仅能提供暂时缓解，而当政策框架健全时，其必要性则显著降低。

abstract: This paper examines optimal currency demands for global equity and bond investors in a large cross-section of developed and emerging markets over the 1975-2023 period. It extends the framework of Campbell et al. (2010) by incorporating both optimal portfolio-risk minimizing currency exposures, accounting for empirically measured hedging costs arising from deviations of Covered Interest Parity (CIP), and optimal expected-return-driven currency demands based on non-zero expected excess currency returns arising from empirically measured deviations of Uncovered Interest Parity (UIP). The analysis shows that the main conclusions of their portfolio risk-minimizing framework hold for this larger and longer panel of countries and that they are robust to deviations from CIP. Specifically, it is optimal for portfolio risk-minimizing equity investors to hold exposures to the U.S. dollar and the euro while avoiding exposure to all other currencies, whereas bond investors should hedge all currency exposures. In contrast, observed deviations from UIP are sufficiently large and persistent among currencies with high average relative interest currencies, especially Emerging Markets currencies, to generate expected return-driven currency demands that offset, and in some cases reverse, portfolio-risk minimizing demands, even for investors with low risk tolerance. The average excess returns on those currencies are large enough to compensate investors for their substantial return volatility and strong positive covariance with equity returns.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1975至2023年间全球发达与新兴市场大截面中，全球股票与债券投资者的最优货币需求。通过拓展Campbell等人（2010）的分析框架，本文同时纳入两类货币需求：一是基于最优投资组合风险最小化的货币敞口，并考虑了由抵补利率平价（CIP）偏离所实际测度的对冲成本；二是基于非零预期超额货币收益（源于无抵补利率平价（UIP）偏离的实际测度）的最优预期收益驱动型货币需求。分析表明，其投资组合风险最小化框架的主要结论在更大、更长的国家面板中依然成立，且对CIP偏离具有稳健性。具体而言，对于追求投资组合风险最小化的股票投资者，最优策略是持有美元和欧元敞口，同时规避所有其他货币敞口；而债券投资者则应完全对冲所有货币敞口。相比之下，在平均相对利率较高的货币（尤其是新兴市场货币）中，UIP偏离的规模足够大且具有持续性，由此产生的预期收益驱动型货币需求会抵消（甚至在某些情况下逆转）投资组合风险最小化需求——即便对于风险容忍度较低的投资者也是如此。这些货币的平均超额收益足以补偿投资者因其高收益波动性以及与股票收益的强正协方差所承担的风险。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Employers facing limited labor market competition may suppress wages below socially optimal levels. Unions can counteract wage suppression through collective bargaining, though they may also push wages above the socially optimal level and lead to job rationing. We estimate a structural model of labor supply, labor demand, and Nash-in-Nash bargaining over wages between local teacher unions and school districts in Pennsylvania’s K-12 public school system from 2013 to 2019. We compare negotiated equilibrium wages and employment to oligopsony wage posting and social planner scenarios. On average, oligopsony reduces wages 7 percent below the social optimum, while collective bargaining raises wages 8 percent above it. Averages mask substantial district-level heterogeneity driven by bargaining power variation. Twenty-eight percent of school districts have salaries lower when public schools are unionized than when they are not due to cross-district externalities, where high salaries at one school cause hiring reductions that increase labor supply elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 面对劳动力市场竞争不足的雇主，可能会将工资压低至社会最优水平以下。工会可以通过集体谈判来抵消工资压制，但也可能将工资推高至社会最优水平以上，并导致工作岗位配给。我们构建了一个包含劳动力供给、劳动力需求以及纳什议价（Nash-in-Nash bargaining）的结构模型，用以分析2013年至2019年间宾夕法尼亚州K-12公立学校系统中地方教师工会与学区之间的工资谈判。我们将谈判达成的均衡工资和就业水平与寡头垄断工资设定及社会规划者情景进行比较。平均而言，寡头垄断使工资低于社会最优水平7%，而集体谈判则使工资高于社会最优水平8%。平均值掩盖了由议价能力差异导致的显著学区层面异质性。28%的学区在公立学校工会化后的工资水平反而低于非工会化状态，这是由于跨学区外部性所致：某一学区的高工资导致招聘减少，从而增加了其他学区的劳动力供给。

abstract: Population censuses constitute the basis of public resource allocation and political representation globally. This paper shows that census forms commonly generate incentives for enumerators to disproportionately omit members of larger households. Using microdata from 254 censuses, we estimate that this leads to undercounting in at least 60% of censuses. Omission is concentrated in poor countries where 0.6% of the population is missing. Within countries, poor households are missing three times as many members as rich ones, leading to larger undercounts in poorer regions. We illustrate how this translates into systematic underfunding of public services and political underrepresentation in poor regions.
abstract_zh: 人口普查是全球公共资源分配和政治代表权的基础。本文表明，普查表格通常会使普查员产生不成比例地遗漏较大规模住户成员的动机。利用254次普查的微观数据，我们估计至少60%的普查中存在此类漏报现象。漏报集中在贫困国家，这些国家有0.6%的人口未被统计。在国家内部，贫困家庭被遗漏的成员数量是富裕家庭的三倍，导致贫困地区的漏报率更高。我们阐释了这种漏报如何转化为贫困地区公共服务资金的系统性不足和政治代表权的缺失。

title: Prenatal Conditions and Midlife Mental Health: Evidence from an Alcohol Policy Experiment

authors: Linnros, Evelina, Nilsson, J Peter
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate the long-term mental health impact of an alcohol policy experiment on individuals exposed to the policy in utero. The policy lasted for 8.5 months and significantly expanded access to alcohol, especially for those under age 21. Armed with administrative data on healthcare visits, drug prescriptions, and psychological assessments and applying a triple-differences strategy, we show that prenatal policy exposure had a substantial, early, and persistent impact on the mental health of the children of young mothers. The exposed cohorts conceived just before the policy started are 16% more likely to be diagnosed with a mental condition in midlife. We find effects on common midlife conditions such as depression and anxiety, on the ability to cope with psychologically stressful situations at age 18, and on neurodevelopmental disorders that manifest in early childhood. Among individuals with predicted mental health care needs, the impact of the policy on midlife earnings is significantly lower when they reside in areas with lower barriers to accessing mental health care, with a one-standard-deviation increase in local treatment intensity reducing the negative earnings effect by about one-third. Our findings indicate that policies increasing access to mental health treatments could substantially improve labor market outcomes, even for conditions with early-life origins.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了某项酒精政策实验对子宫内暴露个体的长期心理健康影响。该政策持续了8.5个月，显著扩大了酒精获取渠道，尤其对21岁以下人群影响显著。利用医疗就诊、处方药及心理评估的行政数据，并采用三重差分策略，我们发现产前政策暴露对年轻母亲子女的心理健康产生了显著、早期且持续的影响。在政策启动前受孕的暴露队列，中年时期被诊断出心理疾病的概率高出16%。我们观察到该政策对常见中年疾病（如抑郁和焦虑）、18岁时应对心理压力情境的能力，以及儿童早期显现的神经发育障碍均存在影响。在预测有心理健康护理需求的个体中，当居住地获取心理护理的障碍较低时，政策对中年收入的负面影响显著减弱——当地治疗强度每增加一个标准差，收入负面效应约减少三分之一。研究结果表明，即便对于具有早期起源的心理疾病，增加心理治疗可及性的政策也能显著改善劳动力市场表现。

abstract: We study consumption stimulus using digital coupons, which provide time-limited subsidies contingent on minimum spending. Analyzing a large-scale program in China, we find that the program generates large and heterogeneous short-term effects. Consumption responses vary across both consumers and locations, reflecting both demand-side and supply-side factors. This heterogeneity shapes the incidence of the program: high-response consumers tend to patronize larger businesses, leading to a regressive allocation of stimulus benefits. Through counterfactual analysis, we show that targeting rules can reshape both the size and distribution of stimulus effects. Targeting the most responsive consumers can more than double the aggregate stimulus, while a hybrid design that combines targeted distribution with direct support to small businesses improves both efficiency and equity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用数字优惠券研究消费刺激，这些优惠券提供基于最低消费额限定的限时补贴。通过分析中国一项大规模项目，我们发现该项目产生了显著且异质性的短期效应。消费反应在消费者和地区间均存在差异，这反映了需求侧与供给侧的双重因素。这种异质性塑造了项目的受益分布：高反应消费者倾向于光顾规模较大的商家，导致刺激福利的分配呈累退性。通过反事实分析，我们表明定向规则能够重塑刺激效应的规模与分布。针对最具响应性的消费者进行定向，可使总体刺激效果翻倍以上，而结合定向发放与对小企业直接支持的混合设计，则能同时提升效率与公平性。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a model where cultural conflict in society and electoral competition are jointly determined. Cultural conservatives and progressives choose, ex ante, their level of tolerance in social relations in response to two sources of threat: the probability of interacting with an intolerant cultural outgroup and the risk of unfavorable cultural policy. Political parties compete on both economic and cultural dimensions. The model shows that as societies gradually shift toward less traditional values, this can, beyond a threshold, trigger endogenous backlash and increased societal intolerance. This backlash shifts political competition from economic to cultural issues, further reinforcing cultural conflict. This two-way interaction can generate multiple equilibria and self-fulfilling “culture wars."
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个模型，将社会中的文化冲突与选举竞争视为内生决定过程。文化保守派与进步派在事前选择其社会关系中的容忍程度，以应对两种威胁来源：与不容忍的文化外群体互动的概率，以及不利文化政策的风险。政党在经济与文化两个维度上展开竞争。模型表明，随着社会逐渐转向非传统价值观，一旦超过某个阈值，便会引发内生性反弹，导致社会不容忍程度加剧。这种反弹将政治竞争从经济议题转向文化议题，进一步强化文化冲突。这种双向互动可能产生多重均衡与自我实现的"文化战争"。

abstract: This paper examines whether the opening of the China-Europe Railway Express (CRE) affects firms’ cross-regional investment. Using subsidiary-level data of Chinese listed firms from 2003 to 2020, we construct a firm-destination city-year panel and find that CRE openings significantly increase firms’ subsidiary establishment in connected cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the CRE promotes firms’ cross-regional investment primarily by improving access to European markets and enhancing cross-border supply-chain efficiency. The effect is stronger for export-oriented firms and is more pronounced in coastal cities and cargo-origin hub cities with higher logistical importance. Evidence from textual classification of subsidiary business scopes further shows that the CRE has a stronger effect on embedded-oriented subsidiaries engaged in production, R&D, and manufacturing than on transit-oriented subsidiaries engaged in trading, logistics, and warehousing. Moreover, the investment response is amplified in cities with stronger industrial agglomeration and higher levels of marketization, highlighting the role of local absorptive capacity. Overall, this paper provides firm-level evidence that cross-border transport infrastructure can reshape firms’ spatial organization layout, and that the related investment exhibits certain features of organizational embeddedness rather than being limited to transit functions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察中欧班列（CRE）开通是否影响企业跨区域投资。基于2003-2020年中国上市公司子公司层面数据，构建企业-目的地城市-年度面板数据后发现，中欧班列开通显著增加了企业在沿线城市的子公司设立数量。机制分析表明，中欧班列主要通过改善欧洲市场准入和提升跨境供应链效率促进企业跨区域投资。该效应在出口导向型企业中更为显著，且在物流重要性更高的沿海城市和货源枢纽城市表现更突出。基于子公司经营范围文本分类的证据进一步显示，相较于从事贸易、物流和仓储的转运导向型子公司，中欧班列对从事生产、研发和制造的嵌入导向型子公司具有更强的促进作用。此外，在产业集聚程度更高、市场化水平更强的城市，企业投资响应更为显著，凸显了地方吸收能力的关键作用。总体而言，本文提供了跨境交通基础设施能够重塑企业空间组织布局的微观证据，并揭示相关投资呈现组织嵌入性特征而非局限于转运功能。

abstract: We provide the first lender-level analysis linking two independently constructed credit supply measures: the Federal Reserve's Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) and credit card mail offers from Mintel Comperemedia. Using a matched panel of 73 banks from 2000 to 2019, we find that quarterly mail volume growth was 18 percent lower when banks reported tightening credit card lending standards, a relationship robust to including credit demand indicators. In addition, SLOOS responses on credit limits and interest rate spreads are also correlated with these terms observed in mail offers. Our findings validate both measures as informative credit supply indicators.
abstract_zh: 我们首次从银行层面出发，将两种独立构建的信贷供给指标联系起来：美联储的高级贷款官意见调查（SLOOS）与Mintel Comperemedia的信用卡邮件报价数据。基于2000年至2019年73家银行的匹配面板数据，研究发现，当银行报告收紧信用卡贷款标准时，季度邮件数量增长率降低18%，这一关系在纳入信贷需求指标后依然稳健。此外，SLOOS中关于信用额度和利差的调查结果，也与邮件报价中观察到的这些条款存在相关性。我们的发现验证了这两种指标作为有效信贷供给指标的价值。

title: Current account imbalances, facts, drivers, and policy challenges

authors: Erik Frohm & John Hooley & Fatih Ozturk & Łukasz Rawdanowicz & Nivetha Sivakumar
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Current account imbalances have re-emerged in global policy debates amid renewed widening, persistence and trade tensions. This paper reviews stylised facts on global imbalances, lessons from past rebalancing episodes, and policy implications. It shows that global imbalances remain persistent and concentrated in a few economies, are shaped more by differences in saving than in investment, and that net international investment positions are strongly influenced by valuation and nominal growth effects. Deficit narrowing is typically accompanied by export growth and higher private saving‑investment balances, especially in firms, while surplus narrowing is more often associated with higher imports and lower net lending across sectors. Larger initial imbalances – especially deficits – are associated with a higher probability of subsequent narrowing. Overall, durable rebalancing is unlikely to be achieved through trade measures or any single policy instrument. Instead, it could benefit from domestically grounded reforms, including fiscal adjustment where needed, and structural measures to reduce excess saving and support investment. Stronger prudential oversight, especially of non-bank financial institutions, would mitigate financial risks. Industrial policy may affect trade balances for individual goods but is unlikely to durably alter aggregate current account positions.
abstract_zh: 经常账户失衡问题在全球政策辩论中再度凸显，其背景是失衡状况持续扩大、长期存在以及贸易紧张局势加剧。本文梳理了全球失衡的典型事实、过往再平衡调整的经验教训及政策启示。研究表明：全球失衡仍具持续性且集中于少数经济体，其形成更多源于储蓄差异而非投资差异；净国际投资头寸受估值效应和名义增长效应影响显著。赤字收窄通常伴随出口增长及私人部门（尤其是企业）储蓄-投资余额提升，而盈余收窄则更多与进口增加及各部门净借贷下降相关。初始失衡规模越大（尤其是赤字），后续收窄概率越高。总体而言，持久性再平衡难以通过贸易措施或单一政策工具实现，而更需依托国内改革——包括必要的财政调整，以及旨在减少过剩储蓄、促进投资的结构性措施。强化审慎监管（尤其针对非银行金融机构）有助于缓解金融风险。产业政策可能影响特定商品贸易差额，但难以持久改变经常账户总体格局。

authors: Dang, Hai-Anh, Kilic, Talip, Abanokova, Kseniya, Dang, Hai-Anh H.
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Can imputed poverty estimates be reliably disaggregated by population groups, especially when the interest is monitoring poverty levels for smaller, vulnerable groups that may not be represented as well in large-scale household surveys? The study tackles this question through a comprehensive literature review and empirical analysis that leverages 18 household surveys across four different low- and middle-income countries. The results suggest that the imputation accuracy widely varies by population group, with differences being as high as 10 percentage points in pairwise comparisons of groups. The imputation accuracy for the population groups of interest increases, on average, by 1.3 percentage points in response to increasing the sample size by 1,000 observations for the target survey that is used for sourcing the predictors for the imputation model. The results are robust to extensive sensitivity analyses and also suggest that incorporating geospatial predictors into the imputation model can help increase imputation accuracy. The discussion provides useful inputs for future survey design.
abstract_zh: 估算贫困数据能否按人口群体可靠分解，尤其是在关注大规模住户调查中可能代表性不足的较小弱势群体贫困监测水平时？本研究通过系统性文献综述和实证分析，利用四个中低收入国家的18项住户调查数据探讨该问题。结果表明，不同人口群体的估算精度差异显著，群体间成对比较的差异最高可达10个百分点。当用于获取估算模型预测变量的目标调查样本量每增加1000个观测值时，关注人口群体的估算精度平均提升1.3个百分点。该结果在广泛的敏感性分析中保持稳健，同时表明将地理空间预测变量纳入估算模型有助于提高估算精度。相关讨论为未来调查设计提供了有益参考。

title: Unconventional monetary policy spillovers and the (in)convenience of Treasuries
title_zh: 非常规货币政策溢出效应与国债的（不）便利性
title_primary: 非常规货币政策溢出效应与国债的（不）便利性
title_secondary: Unconventional monetary policy spillovers and the (in)convenience of Treasuries
authors: Karlye Dilts Stedman, Andrew Hanson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Foreign monetary policy shocks increasingly influence U.S. yields, particularly since the Global Financial Crisis. We show that this heightened sensitivity reflects both the adoption of unconventional monetary policy tools and a decline in the convenience of Treasuries. Using high frequency identification, we find that when Treasuries command a low convenience premium—behaving more like other assets—they respond more to ECB monetary policy, consistent with increased sensitivity to portfolio rebalancing. A two-country preferred-habitat model with time-varying covariance of yields rationalizes these results: when Treasuries are less convenient, they become closer substitutes for foreign equivalents, amplifying cross-border transmission of policy shocks.
abstract_zh: 外国货币政策冲击对美国收益率的影响日益增强，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。我们证明，这种敏感性的提升既反映了非常规货币政策工具的采用，也反映了美国国债便利性的下降。利用高频识别方法，我们发现，当美国国债的便利溢价较低——其行为更类似于其他资产时，它们对欧洲央行货币政策的反应更为显著，这与投资组合再平衡敏感性的增强相一致。一个具有时变收益率协方差的两国偏好栖息地模型为这些结果提供了理论解释：当美国国债便利性降低时，它们与外国同类资产的替代性增强，从而放大了政策冲击的跨境传导效应。

title_primary: 零下限以下的家庭行为

authors: Asger Lau Andersen, Niels Johannesen, Jens Brøndum Petersen, Sonja Settele, Johannes Wohlfart
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

title: Ranking teams
title_zh: 团队排名
title_primary: 团队排名
title_secondary: Ranking teams
authors: Adam Hamdan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A principal wants to rank and reward teams in an organization. Agents perfectly observe the local ranking of their teams, and strictly prefer being on higher-ranking teams. I show there exists an ex-post incentive compatible and efficient team ranking mechanism if (i) there is an agent who belongs to every team (supervisor condition), or (ii) whenever two teams share an agent in common, they share at least two agents in common (connectivity condition). I identify a class of organizations for which these conditions are both necessary and sufficient. In the special case where the principal wants to rank every group of co-workers in the organization, there exists a team ranking mechanism if and only if the organizational network is a star.
abstract_zh: 委托人希望对组织中的团队进行排名并给予奖励。代理人能够完全观察到其所在团队的局部排名，并且严格偏好于排名更高的团队。我证明，若满足以下任一条件，则存在一种事后激励相容且高效的团队排名机制：(i) 存在一位属于所有团队的代理人（监督者条件），或 (ii) 当两个团队共享一名共同代理人时，它们至少共享两名共同代理人（连通性条件）。我识别出一类组织，在这些组织中，上述条件既是必要的也是充分的。在委托人希望对组织中每一组同事进行排名的特殊情形下，存在团队排名机制当且仅当组织网络为星形结构。

title: The impact of hardening local government budget constraints on corporate digital transformation: evidence from China
title_zh: 硬化地方政府预算约束对企业数字化转型的影响：来自中国的证据

title_secondary: The impact of hardening local government budget constraints on corporate digital transformation: evidence from China
authors: Jing Yan, Yan Wang, Xinyi Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Strengthening the management of local government debt is crucial for safeguarding national economic and financial security. As a central instrument for regulating government borrowing and preventing local debt risks, whether hardening budget constraints generates spillover effects on firms’ digital transformation remains an open question. From the perspective of China’s ongoing efforts to reinforce fiscal discipline, this study examines the impact and mechanisms of local government budget constraint hardening on corporate digital transformation, using matched data on listed firms and regional debt conditions. Our baseline evidence indicates that tighter budget constraints significantly accelerate firms’ digital upgrading. Mechanism analyses show that the effect operates primarily through the reallocation of financial resources and the improvement of internal corporate governance. Heterogeneity results further demonstrate that the promoting role of fiscal discipline is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, firms operating in competitive industries, and capital-intensive producers. By uncovering how macro-level fiscal reforms shape micro-level strategic transformation, this paper enriches the literature on the real effects of local government budget constraint hardening and provides new empirical evidence on the institutional foundations of corporate upgrading.
abstract_zh: 加强地方政府债务管理对于维护国家经济和金融安全至关重要。作为规范政府借贷、防范地方债务风险的核心工具，硬化预算约束是否会对企业数字化转型产生溢出效应，仍是一个待解的问题。本文基于中国持续推进财政纪律强化的背景，利用上市公司与区域债务状况的匹配数据，考察了地方政府预算约束硬化对企业数字化转型的影响及其作用机制。基准结果表明，预算约束的收紧显著加速了企业的数字化升级。机制分析显示，这一效应主要通过金融资源的重新配置和内部公司治理的改善发挥作用。异质性结果进一步表明，财政纪律的促进作用在非国有企业、竞争性行业企业以及资本密集型生产者中更为显著。通过揭示宏观财政改革如何塑造微观战略转型，本文丰富了关于地方政府预算约束硬化实际效应的文献，并为企业升级的制度基础提供了新的经验证据。

title: Investment Sophistication and Wealth Inequality
title_zh: 投资成熟度与财富不平等
title_primary: 投资成熟度与财富不平等
title_secondary: Investment Sophistication and Wealth Inequality
authors: Ehsan Azarmsa
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study the stationary wealth distribution in a dynamic model of financial markets in which investors differ in their levels of investment sophistication. Some investors form beliefs rationally but have access to different information, while others hold incorrect beliefs. For all investor types, the stationary wealth distribution exhibits a thick upper tail, whose thickness depends on the higher moments of portfolio returns relative to the aggregate market. The upper tail of the overall stationary wealth distribution is populated by the group with the thickest tail. I show that this group is either a rational group with an undominated information set or the group with incorrect beliefs, despite the latter earning the lowest expected return. To explain the observed degrees of wealth concentration, it is sufficient that some investor groups earn an expected excess return of 0.89% per annum relative to the aggregate economy – consistent with the risk-adjusted returns generated by hedge funds and private equity funds and their portfolio shares among the ultra-wealthy in the United States. A calibration of the model matches the distribution of average returns for Norwegian households documented by Fagereng et al. (2020).
abstract_zh: 我研究了一个动态金融市场模型中的稳态财富分布，其中投资者的投资 sophistication 水平各异。部分投资者理性形成信念但获取的信息不同，而其他投资者则持有错误信念。对于所有投资者类型，稳态财富分布均呈现厚尾特征，其厚度取决于投资组合收益相对于整体市场的更高阶矩。整体稳态财富分布的上尾部分由尾部最厚的群体占据。我证明，这一群体要么是拥有无支配信息集的理性群体，要么是持有错误信念的群体，尽管后者获得的预期收益最低。为解释观察到的财富集中程度，只需某些投资者群体相对于整体经济每年获得0.89%的预期超额收益即可——这与对冲基金和私募股权基金产生的风险调整后收益及其在美国超级富豪中的投资组合份额相符。模型校准结果与Fagereng等人（2020）记录的挪威家庭平均收益分布相匹配。

title: The Welfare and Distributional Consequences of Corporate Tax Cuts in Open Economies

title_primary: 开放经济中企业减税的福利与分配效应
title_secondary: The Welfare and Distributional Consequences of Corporate Tax Cuts in Open Economies
authors: MAMOON KADER, HASHMAT KHAN, MINJOON LEE, RAÚL RAZO‐GARCÍA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop an open‐economy heterogeneous household model with incomplete markets to quantitatively evaluate the welfare and distributional effects—both within and across countries—of the corporate tax cut (Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, TCJA) implemented in the U.S. in 2017. The model allows for examining outcomes under various possibilities including the tax cut in the U.S. being permanent versus temporary and potential fiscal responses of other countries to the TCJA. We find that the TCJA is regressive in the U.S. and has relatively more regressive outcomes in other countries. Whether the wealth‐poor in the U.S. benefit from the TCJA or not depends on the persistence of the tax cut. Finally, when a small country reduces its corporate tax in response to the TCJA, it has a progressive distributional result in its own economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全市场的开放经济异质性家庭模型，以定量评估2017年美国实施的企业减税政策（《减税与就业法案》，TCJA）在国内外产生的福利与分配效应。该模型允许考察多种情景下的结果，包括美国减税政策的永久性与临时性差异，以及其他国家可能采取的财政应对措施。研究发现：TCJA在美国具有累退性，且在其他国家产生了更显著的累退效应；美国财富匮乏群体能否从TCJA中获益取决于减税政策的持续性；当小国为应对TCJA而降低本国企业税率时，其国内将呈现累进性的分配结果。

title: Drivers of Precision Agriculture Adoption in Italian Viticulture
title_zh: 意大利葡萄栽培中精准农业采纳的驱动因素

title_secondary: Drivers of Precision Agriculture Adoption in Italian Viticulture
authors: Olimpia Fontana, Linda Arata, Margherita Muzzillo, Paolo Sckokai
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the main drivers influencing the adoption of two types of precision farming technologies in the viticultural sector: Decision Support Systems (DSSs) and Variable Rate Technologies (VRTs). We apply a partial proportional odds model and find that socio‐demographic characteristics are not significant determinants of adoption, whereas farm structural features and a general positive attitude toward technology significantly increase the likelihood of uptake. Environmental concern plays a role only with respect to the intention to adopt, but not in explaining actual adoption behavior. Moreover, farmers' perceptions of the usefulness of digital technologies and the difficulties associated with their use emerge as key factors shaping adoption intentions among non‐adopters. These results suggest that targeted training initiatives and strengthened advisory services could play a crucial role in fostering the diffusion of precision farming technologies in viticulture.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了影响葡萄种植业采纳两类精准农业技术的主要驱动因素：决策支持系统（DSSs）与变量施肥技术（VRTs）。通过应用部分比例优势模型，本研究发现社会人口特征并非技术采纳的显著决定因素，而农场结构特征及对技术的普遍积极态度则显著提升了采纳概率。环境关注仅在采纳意愿层面发挥作用，但无法解释实际采纳行为。此外，农户对数字技术实用性的认知及使用困难程度，成为影响非采纳者采纳意愿的关键因素。这些结果表明，针对性的培训计划与强化咨询服务可在促进葡萄种植业精准农业技术推广中发挥关键作用。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper articulates and, using newly-assembled data, explores how international taxation affects aggregate tangible cross-border investment. Spillovers from statutory tax rates abroad seem: As sizable as effects from the host’s rate; larger than previous consensus values (attributed to a systematic bias from FDI data); and consistent with ‘implicit’ profit shifting through real investment (rather than ‘paper’ profit shifting). Contrary to much policy discussion, the results also imply that: Host countries’ marginal effective tax rates have at best a weak effect on real investment; those elsewhere have none; and, applied to the prospective global minimum tax, inward tangible investment in most sample countries will increase.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述并利用新汇编的数据，探讨国际税收如何影响总体有形跨境投资。来自国外的法定税率溢出效应似乎：与东道国税率的影响一样大；大于先前共识值（归因于FDI数据的系统性偏差）；并与通过实际投资进行的“隐性”利润转移（而非“纸面”利润转移）相一致。与许多政策讨论相反，结果还表明：东道国的边际有效税率对实际投资的影响至多微弱；其他地方的税率则无影响；并且，应用于拟议的全球最低税时，大多数样本国家的内向有形投资将会增加。

title: Feeding the accelerator: A metabolic historical analysis of the US food regime
title_zh: 喂养加速器：美国食物体制的代谢历史分析
title_primary: 喂养加速器：美国食物体制的代谢历史分析
title_secondary: Feeding the accelerator: A metabolic historical analysis of the US food regime
authors: Stefano Menegat
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study combines food regime analysis with a metabolic accounting approach to reconstruct the long-run viability conditions of the US “cheap food” regime. We compile a harmonized dataset for 1840–2017 (census benchmark years) and apply Multi-Scale Integrated Analysis of Societal and Ecosystem Metabolism (MuSIASEM) together with Impredicative Loop Analysis to quantify the co-evolution of agricultural output, labor time, and societal reproduction requirements. The results reveal a recurrent pattern of surplus generation and reconfiguration that supports a three-phase periodization: (i) accumulation by appropriation (1840–1890), (ii) accumulation by capitalization (1930–1970), and (iii) reorganization (1990s onward). Within the metabolic indicators used here, the 1930s stand out as the clearest systemic rupture, whereas later crises are associated with re-stabilization strategies that maintain surplus rates through technological change, state regulation, and evolving capitalization dynamics. The analysis also highlights the central role of commodity frontiers—most notably cheap oil—in sustaining postwar agro-industrial productivity, and it discusses the emergence of “cheap information” as a potential new frontier layered onto persistent petro-farming. By operationalizing food-regime narratives through a formal metabolic grammar, the study offers a reproducible way to interpret agrarian crises as expressions of contradictions between appropriation and capitalization, and to link regime stability to the biophysical and labor conditions of social reproduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究将粮食体制分析与代谢核算方法相结合，重构了美国“廉价粮食”体制的长期可持续性条件。我们编制了1840—2017年（人口普查基准年）的统一数据集，并应用社会与生态系统代谢的多尺度综合分析（MuSIASEM）及不可预测循环分析，量化了农业产出、劳动时间与社会再生产需求之间的协同演化。结果揭示了剩余生成与重构的反复模式，支持三阶段分期：（i）通过占有实现积累（1840—1890年），（ii）通过资本化实现积累（1930—1970年），以及（iii）重组阶段（1990年代起）。在本研究使用的代谢指标中，1930年代是最明显的系统性断裂点，而后续危机则与通过技术变革、国家调控及不断演化的资本化动态维持剩余率的再稳定策略相关。分析还强调了商品边界——尤其是廉价石油——在维持战后农业工业生产力中的核心作用，并讨论了“廉价信息”作为潜在新边界，叠加于持续存在的石油农业之上的兴起。通过以形式化的代谢语法操作粮食体制叙事，本研究提供了一种可复现的方式，将农业危机解释为占有与资本化之间矛盾的表现，并将体制稳定性与社会再生产的生物物理及劳动条件联系起来。

title: Can early public childcare reduce child penalties? Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 早期公共托育能否减少育儿惩罚？来自德国的证据
title_primary: 早期公共托育能否减少育儿惩罚？来自德国的证据

authors: Lisa-Marie Duletzki, Nayeon Lim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the effects of public childcare expansion for children under age three in Germany on mothers’ child penalties. Exploiting county-level variation in the expansion, we find that a 20-percentage-point increase in childcare coverage rate reduces earnings penalties by 4.5 percentage points. This accounts for about 56% of the total 8-percentage-point decline in earnings penalties over the reform period. Early childcare increases employment and days worked, especially in full-time and non-marginal positions. It also raises daily wages and increases the likelihood that mothers work in higher-paying firms and occupations. These effects persist beyond the early childcare eligibility period. We further identify two key contextual factors explaining the positive effects of early childcare: the initial level of child penalties and reliance on informal care. In settings with high child penalties and limited alternatives, early public childcare can yield substantial lasting benefits for mothers’ careers. • Germany substantially expanded public childcare for children under age three. • This expansion persistently reduced mothers’ child penalties. • Mothers work more, earn higher wages, and sort into full-time and better-paying jobs. • Effects are larger where child penalties are high and informal care is scarce.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了德国三岁以下儿童公共托育服务的扩展对母亲育儿惩罚的影响。利用县级扩展差异，我们发现儿童托育覆盖率每提高20个百分点，收入惩罚降低4.5个百分点。这占改革期间收入惩罚总下降8个百分点中的约56%。早期托育增加了就业和工作天数，尤其是在全职和非边缘岗位中。同时，它提高了日工资，并增加了母亲在薪酬更高企业和职业中工作的可能性。这些效应在早期托育资格期结束后依然持续。我们进一步识别出两个关键背景因素，用以解释早期托育的积极效应：初始育儿惩罚水平和对照料非正式照料的依赖。在育儿惩罚高且替代选择有限的背景下，早期公共托育能为母亲的职业生涯带来显著且持久的益处。• 德国大幅扩展了三岁以下儿童的公共托育服务。• 这一扩展持续降低了母亲的育儿惩罚。• 母亲工作更多，工资更高，并转向全职和薪酬更优的工作。• 在育儿惩罚高且非正式照料稀缺的地区，效应更为显著。

title: Policy Biases in a Model with Labor‐Market Frictions
title_zh: 劳动力市场摩擦模型中的政策偏向
title_primary: 劳动力市场摩擦模型中的政策偏向
title_secondary: Policy Biases in a Model with Labor‐Market Frictions
authors: RICHARD DENNIS, TATIANA KIRSANOVA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-02-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a model with labor‐market matching frictions that is subject to a range of shocks, including shocks to matching efficiency and bargaining power, and use the model to examine how monetary policy should respond to such shocks. We show that optimal monetary policy responds effectively to these shocks, producing economic outcomes that are close to the flex‐price equilibrium. Moreover, this effectiveness remains if monetary policy is conducted with discretion, indicating that time inconsistency and forward guidance are not central to the policy response.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含劳动力市场匹配摩擦的模型，该模型受到一系列冲击的影响，包括匹配效率和议价能力的冲击，并利用该模型探讨货币政策应如何应对这些冲击。研究表明，最优货币政策能有效应对这些冲击，使经济结果接近弹性价格均衡。此外，即便在相机抉择的货币政策下，这种有效性依然存在，这表明时间不一致性和前瞻指引并非政策应对的核心要素。

title: The Consequences of Soil Organic Carbon for Crop Yield, Farm Productivity and Profit
title_zh: 土壤有机碳对作物产量、农场生产力及利润的影响
title_primary: 土壤有机碳对作物产量、农场生产力及利润的影响
title_secondary: The Consequences of Soil Organic Carbon for Crop Yield, Farm Productivity and Profit
authors: Devin Allen Serfas
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-05-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Crop choices affect soil organic carbon (SOC) stocks, allowing farmers to manipulate the amount of carbon sequestered in the soil over time. This paper examines the private and public benefits of crop rotations that sequester additional carbon across the province of Saskatchewan, Canada using a novel field‐level dataset from the Saskatchewan Crop Insurance Corporation matched with data on weather, soil and simulated SOC. I begin by estimating the on‐farm shadow value of SOC using a dynamic panel regression model and find that it is positive with diminishing marginal returns; the yield (and thus profit) response to SOC is larger in soil zones with less SOC and smaller in soil zones with more SOC. I then use dynamic simulations to estimate the SOC and yield response to different crop rotations over time. The adoption of the Canola‐Spring Wheat‐Peas‐Spring Wheat crop rotation leads to a 27.5%, 8.2% and 4.4% increase in long‐term average profit compared to current levels in the brown, dark brown and black & grey soil zones attributable to increased SOC over 32 years of average weather conditions. Finally, I compute the external social benefit from the Canola‐Spring Wheat‐Peas‐Spring Wheat rotation relative to Spring Wheat‐Fallow‐Spring Wheat‐Fallow on all insurable hectares in Saskatchewan from 2023 to 2055, and find benefits amounting to 108 billion CAD when employing a social cost of carbon of 185 USD/Mg of CO 2 . These results show that selecting crop rotations that have greater SOC sequestration potential not only improves on‐farm profitability over time, but can generate substantial environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 作物选择影响土壤有机碳（SOC）储量，使农民能够随时间推移调控土壤中固存的碳量。本文利用来自萨斯喀彻温省作物保险公司的田间级新数据集，结合天气、土壤及模拟SOC数据，考察了加拿大萨斯喀彻温省境内能够额外固碳的作物轮作所带来的私人及公共效益。首先，我采用动态面板回归模型估算SOC的农场内影子价值，发现其为正且边际回报递减；在SOC含量较低的土壤区域，产量（进而利润）对SOC的响应较大，而在SOC含量较高的土壤区域，响应较小。随后，我运用动态模拟评估不同作物轮作随时间对SOC和产量的影响。在平均天气条件下持续32年，采用油菜-春小麦-豌豆-春小麦轮作相较于当前水平，在棕色、深棕色及黑灰色土壤区域，因SOC增加导致长期平均利润分别提高27.5%、8.2%和4.4%。最后，我计算了2023年至2055年间，在萨斯喀彻温省所有可投保公顷土地上，油菜-春小麦-豌豆-春小麦轮作相对于春小麦-休耕-春小麦-休耕轮作所产生的外部社会效益，发现采用185美元/吨二氧化碳的社会碳成本时，效益总额达1080亿加元。这些结果表明，选择具有更高SOC固存潜力的作物轮作不仅能随时间提升农场盈利能力，还能产生显著的环境效益。

title: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
title_zh: 代际消费与收入不平等
title_primary: 代际消费与收入不平等
title_secondary: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
authors: Giovanni Gallipoli, Hamish Low, Aruni Mitra
official: 官方在线 2024-09-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We characterize the joint evolution of cross-sectional inequality in earnings, other sources of income and consumption across generations in the U.S. To account for cross-sectional dispersion, we estimate a model of intergenerational persistence and separately identify the influences of parental factors and of idiosyncratic life-cycle components. We find evidence of family persistence in earnings, consumption and saving behaviours, and marital sorting patterns. However, the quantitative contribution of idiosyncratic heterogeneity to cross-sectional inequality is significantly larger than parental effects. Our estimates imply that intergenerational persistence is not high enough to induce further large increases in inequality over time and across generations.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了代际间收入与消费不平等的联合演变过程。我们构建了一个包含代际持续性及家庭独立异质性特征的模型。研究发现，收入与消费不平等主要源于异质性因素而非代际关联。实证结果表明，消费对终身收入异质性风险具有保险功能，尤其体现在收入最低和最高四分位群体中。仅对收入最高四分位群体而言，父母收入构成此类保险的重要来源。
